newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Thermo Optek Q2 shr $0.20 vs $0.13.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Thermo Optek Q2 shr $0.20 vs $0.13.

text.p: Three Months Ended(A) Six Months Ended(A)

NOTE(A): The company has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the Spectronic Instruments Inc subsidiary of Life Sciences International from Thermo Instrument Systems Inc. (THI.A) for approximately $40 million, which includes the assumption of approximately $20 million in intercompany debt.

In addition, the company agreed to acquire the VG Systems subsidiary of Thermo Instrument for approximately $45 million in cash. Due to Thermo Optek's majority ownership by Thermo Instrument, for accounting purposes, the acquisition of Spectronic is deemed effective as of March 12, 1997, the date Thermo Instrument purchased Life Sciences International, and its results have been included from that date.
The results of VG Systems have been included from March 29, 1996, the date it was acquired by Thermo Instrument.
Full company name is Thermo Optek Corp.
